name: Wind Cutter
description:
Perform up to **4** consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting the skill to perform **Basic Attack Stage 3** directly.

Hold Normal Attack after casting **Basic Attack Stage 3**, Dodge Counter, or Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack Razor Wind. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
- Press Normal Attack shortly after landing to cast **Basic Attack Stage 4**.
- At max Windstrings, press Normal Attack shortly after landing to cast Resonance Skill Unbound Flow.

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

name: Illusion Breaker
description:
Jump up into the mid-air and slash the target, dealing Aero DMG.

While in mid-air, press Resonance Skill to deal Aero DMG, which removes all stacks of Spectro Frazzle, Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Electro Flare from the target hit and inflicts **1** stack of Aero Erosion for each stack removed.

name: Omega Storm
description:
Unleash the power of the Eye of Tempest, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

name: Cycle of Wind
description:
Perform up to **2** consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following **3** ways:
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Resonance Skill Awakening Gale.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Intro Skill.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Heavy Attack Razor Wind.
When casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance, hold Normal Attack to perform Mid-air Attack.

At max Windstrings, Resonance Skill Awakening Gale becomes Resonance Skill Unbound Flow: Perform up to **2** consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes **60** Windstrings, dealing Aero DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Switching to another Resonator after Stage **1** automatically triggers Stage **2** of this skill.

Rover can hold up to **120** Windstrings.
Each stage of Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance restores **25** Windstrings on hit.
Casting Intro Skill restores **20** Windstrings.
Hitting a target with **Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4** or Dodge Counter restores **10** Windstrings.

name: Sand in the Storm
description: Casting Intro Skill Relentless Squall increases ATK by **20%** for **10s**.

name: Boundless Winds
description: Increase Healing from Resonance Liberation Omega Storm by **20%**.

name: Relentless Squall
description: Deal Aero DMG.

name: Storm's Echo
description:
Grant Aeolian Realm to all nearby Resonators in the team for **30s**. Aeolian Realm effect:
- Upon hitting a target, increase the maximum stack of Aero Erosion the target can receive by **3** for **10s**. This effect is not stackable.

name: Storm Subsides in the Void
description: Casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance enhances Rover's resistance to interruption for **3s**.

name: Glimmers Fade into the Dark
description: Casting Resonance Skill Unbound Flow continuously restores HP for the Resonator on the field by **20%** of Rover's ATK every **3s** for **30s**. When the Resonator on the field has an HP lower than **35%**, immediately restore **10%** of their lost HP. This restoration effect can be triggered once every **10s** and will not be affected by any Healing Bonus.

name: Illusions Collapse in a Grip
description: Aero DMG Bonus is increased by **15%**.

name: Boundaries Shatter in an Instant
description: Casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by **15%** for **5s**.

name: Life and Death Intertwine
description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Omega Storm is increased by **20%**.

name: All Crumble in the Wind
description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Unbound Flow is increased by **30%**.

name: Deterrence
description:
Perform up to **4** consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA.
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes **60%** less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast **Basic Attack Stage 2**.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Perform up to **3** consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage **3** of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after to perform **Basic Attack Stage 3**.

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

name: Thunderclap
description: Launch the Cloudrift Bolt and grapple towards the target, dealing Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after to cast Basic Attack - Repel, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

name: Ultimate Tactics
description: Launch the Thunder Quietus, dealing Electro DMG.

name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
description:
At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform **Normal Attack Stage 4**.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by pressing the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team **10%** ATK Bonus for **20s**.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume **60** points of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes **10%** Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to launch up to **7** consecutive attacks:
- The first **3** stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next **3** stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last **1** stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, press Resonance Skill to perform up to **6** stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first **3** stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next **2** stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last **1** stage: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Press Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, press Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

Rover can hold up to **120** points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

Rover can hold up to **100** points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.

name: Decipher
description: Resonance Skill Overshock inflicts **10** stacks of Electro Flare on the target it damages.

name: Regression
description: When Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, gain **20%** Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for **20s**. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

name: Thunderous Fury
description: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

name: Rumbling Thunders
description:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for **20s** or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain **25%** All DMG Amplification for **14s**. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.

name: Celestial Ingenuity
description: While casting Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds, gain increased resistance to interruption for **0.5s**.

name: Thousandfold Artifice
description: Inflict **5** stacks of Electro Flare on the targets hit after Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics deals damage.

name: Alchemy of Wonders
description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Overshock is increased by **20%**.

name: Earthquaking Rumble
description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics is increased by **20%**.

name: Principle of Change
description: Crit. DMG is increased by **20%** while in Apex Resonance.

name: Mind's Depths in a Casket
description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds and Thunder Bane is increased by **20%**.
